exclusion_rules.aln3_loader_filter: a DTU inventory trial that auditory_alignment.data.load_dtu does not load, as C5 records it in checks.inventory_reconciliation.not_loaded: status 'excluded' (load_dtu's trial filter; reason per trial, from excluded_trials) or 'unread_file' (in a file load_dtu never opens; reason per file, from unread_files); any other status refuses the build (design §3.3, §3.5)
exclusion_rules.clock_misaligned: C2 clock-validity rule (§3.2): both halves measurable (z >= 5), |tau_1 - tau_2| <= 4 and |mean tau| > 4 samples; C4 slab excluded_rule; never shifted
exclusion_rules.declared_structural_exclusion: a run excluded explicitly by this manifest before any donor result (DECLARED_EXCLUSIONS; reason per entry); its segments carry role excluded_declared and enter no pool
exclusion_rules.readme_flagged: a run the dataset README flags; asserted absent from the re-host (C1 readme_flagged_absent and no runs.json row)
exclusion_rules.restricted_participant: access-restricted SparrKULee participant (dataset_description.json Notes of the re-host): listed from file names and .npy headers only (C1); no array of theirs is opened by any job
exclusion_rules.structural_anomaly_unverified_clock: C1 structural-anomaly rule (|T_eeg - modal co-listener T_eeg| > 8 samples) and a C2 clock that is not 'aligned' (§3.2); C4 slab excluded_rule

exclusion_summary.rule: C2 'unverifiable' runs are never excluded for their class (F11: never excluded for weak tracking). unverifiable_kept counts the unverifiable runs in a donor role (fit / dev / bridge_cal) that no listed exclusion removes; unverifiable_by_role gives the C4 role of every unverifiable run (holdout_seen_content and control_artefact runs enter no pool by their role, excluded_rule ones by C1's structural rule); unverifiable_declared_excluded lists those a declared structural exclusion removes

conflicts: design §1: the outputs of the scout aln34_sparrk/decoder_lag.py are 'not used for any decision' (that scout also audited the restricted participant 026, audiobook_1); this exclusion rests on one of them
design §3.2 and F11: SparrKULee runs are excluded only by the two fixed rules, and a C2 'unverifiable' run is kept; C2's registered rule classes this run 'unverifiable'
detail.reason: declared structural exclusion required by task M2e, fixed before any donor result and departing from design §3.2 / F11. Basis: the design scout's backward-decoder audit (aln34_sparrk/decoder_lag.py -> prior33_provenance/aln34_sparrk/decoder_lag.json, sha256 225bc8c4..., entry 051:audiobook_12_2) gives tau -566 samples (-8.84 s) in a +-10 s search, with r_peak 0.0517. Its off-peak maximum is defined relative to zero lag (|tau| > 1 s), so it includes this peak and does not measure its prominence; this audit is the source of design §1's 'one run misaligned by -566 samples' and of §3.2's expectation that C2 classes the run misaligned. C2's own +-10 s diagnostic (restricted-free references; descriptive only) also peaks there: -566 over the run (z 4.04), -568 / -565 in the halves (z 3.29 / 3.12, below the measurability threshold z >= 5). C2's registered +-40 s clock-validity rule classes the run 'unverifiable': tau-hat -1668 / -2220 samples, z 3.40 / 3.19 (neither half measurable; the halves disagree), which §3.2 / F11 would keep. Conflicts: §1 bars every output of decoder_lag.py from any decision; §3.2 / F11 keep unverifiable runs. The run is excluded here explicitly instead of being kept by the rule
detail.required_by: task M2e (lead): 'exclude it explicitly as a declared structural exclusion and say so'
